summary: Defines a way to subscribe to a whole list of resources in SIP by putting the list inside the body of a single SUBSCRIBE request. Instead of one subscription per resource, the subscriber gets notifications about all of them through one dialog. This is a Proposed Standard that updates RFC 3265.

eli5.summary: Imagine ordering for a whole table by handing the waiter one list, instead of calling him over once for every dish. You ask once, and he keeps you posted on everything on the list.

questions: how to subscribe to a list of resources in sip
sip subscribe with resource list in request body
